skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the fundamental concepts of international marketing, including the nature of international marketing, the planning and strategy process, environmental analysis, customer behavior, and resource analysis in an international marketing context, and the management of marketing mix tools.
Evaluate a business's ability to enter international markets, choose target markets, and select appropriate market entry strategies.

Adapt and manage marketing programs for international markets, integrating knowledge of international marketing with foundational knowledge of economics and business management to identify and solve international marketing problems.
Analyze the impact of environmental and resource factors on international marketing activities.
Conduct market segmentation, target market selection, and strategic management of the marketing mix in international markets.
Manage the implementation, evaluation, control, and adjustment of international marketing activities within a business.
Work effectively in a dynamic and flexible group environment, contributing to group discussions and supporting other group members.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve international marketing problems.
Develop and deliver effective presentations on international marketing topics.
Write comprehensive reports on international marketing strategies and activities.
